## User need

Who needs this, and what should they be able to do?

## Proposed behavior

Describe one concrete flow and relevant failure/fallback behavior.

## Acceptance criteria

List observable outcomes, including fixture/GPU-off behavior and isolated validation.

## Scope and dependencies

List affected components, proposed contract changes and dependencies. The integrator assigns allowed paths.

## Costs and data

Identify new provider calls, retained data, consent requirements and budget controls where applicable.
Do not include secrets or personal media.
